source:
@@U03494@@
Forget where you came from and honor these sacred oaks.

@@U03496@@
Forget what’s left behind? How do you do that? What once you had is always Paradise. But tell me. Whar’s that squatting in the dusk of that cave down there? Is it three of them I see?

@@U03498@@
Ah! The 福耳库斯三女妖! Yes! Visit them if you dare— if it doesn’t turn your blood to ice.

@@U03500@@
Why not? What I see—what I see astonishes me! I may be proud, but I must admit I’ve never seen the like! They're worse than mandrakes! How will the most vile of sins compare when faced with this triple monster? Not the most horrendous of our Hells could endure the sight of them at Hell Mouth. But here they are, in this land of beauty called classical. They're stirring— they seem to have sensed me— twittering, whistling, gibbering like vampire bats.

@@U03502@@
Sisters, pass me the eye, to see who's drawing near our sanctuary.
translation:
@@U03494@@
忘记你来自哪里，尊重这些神圣的橡树。

@@U03496@@
忘记留下了什么？你是怎么做到的？曾经拥有的永远是天堂。但请告诉我。蹲在下面那个洞穴的黄昏里的是什么？我看到的是他们三个吗？

@@U03498@@
啊！福耳库斯三女妖！是的！如果你有胆量，就去拜访他们吧——如果这不会让你的血液凝固。

@@U03500@@
为什么不呢？我所看到的——我所看到的让我惊讶！我可能很自豪，但我必须承认我从未见过这样的事情！它们比曼德拉草还要糟糕！罪孽最深的，面对这三重怪物又如何？我们地狱中最可怕的人都无法忍受在地狱口看到他们。但他们就在这里，在这片被称为古典的美丽土地上。他们在动——他们似乎感觉到了我——像吸血蝙蝠一样叽叽喳喳、吹口哨、胡言乱语。

@@U03502@@
姐妹们，请让我看看谁正在靠近我们的圣所。
